pipeline: PROVIDER → MODEL → CAPABILITY → ACCOUNT → QUOTA → ROUTER → FALLBACK → EXECUTION
rules: executes only a route already selected by 10.6/10.7 and revalidated by 10.7 candidateSelectable
does not choose models, create routes, or switch accounts
does not retry, rotate, or fallback automatically — one route, one attempt
does not coerce unknown quota/capacity to available
resolves credential_ref only through CredentialResolver; secret never leaves the call
never stores, logs, or returns secrets
does not write canonical memory (CAPTURE → GATE → COMMIT → SYNC unchanged)
does not invent telemetry — optional onEvent hook only (10.10)
